title: Row-Stochastic Matrices Can Provably Outperform Doubly Stochastic Matrices in Decentralized Learning
abstract: arXiv:2511.19513v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Decentralized learning often involves a weighted global loss with heterogeneous node weights $\lambda$. We revisit two natural strategies for incorporating these weights: (i) embedding them into the local losses to retain a uniform weight (and thus a doubly stochastic matrix), and (ii) keeping the original losses while employing a $\lambda$-induced row-stochastic matrix. Although prior work shows that both strategies target the same $\lambda$-weighted global loss, it remains unclear whether the Euclidean-space guarantees are tight and what fundamentally differentiates their behaviors. translated_title: 行随机矩阵在去中心化学习中可证明优于双随机矩阵
translated_abstract: 去中心化学习通常涉及具有异构节点权重$\lambda$的加权全局损失。我们重新审视了两种自然的策略来纳入这些权重：（i）将其嵌入到局部损失中以保持均匀权重（从而使用双随机矩阵），以及（ii）保留原始损失，同时采用由$\lambda$诱导的行随机矩阵。尽管先前的研究表明这两种策略都针对相同的$\lambda$加权全局损失，但尚不清楚欧几里得空间中的保证是否紧致，以及它们的行为有何根本区别。为了澄清这一点，我们开发了一个加权希尔伯特空间框架$L^2(\lambda;\mathbb{R}^d)$，并获得了比标准欧几里得分析严格更紧的收敛速率。在这种几何中，行随机矩阵变得\emph{自伴}，而双随机矩阵则不然，从而产生了额外的\emph{惩罚项}，这些项会...
tldr: 本文通过引入加权希尔伯特空间框架，严格证明了在去中心化学习中，行随机矩阵在收敛速度上优于双随机矩阵，并揭示了其自伴性质带来的优势。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a weighted Hilbert-space framework to rigorously prove that row-stochastic matrices achieve faster convergence than doubly stochastic matrices in decentralized learning, highlighting advantages from their self-adjoint property.
